description: Resume a paused series. Refused with SERIES_NEEDS_CREDITS when the balance cannot pay the next video, and with SERIES_LIMIT_REACHED at 5 active series. Creating or changing a series is FREE. While active, the scheduler makes one video every scheduleIntervalDays (the first at its next run, within about 30 minutes) and charges each video like any video, 40 credits with the default render, at render time. It needs at least 40 credits in the balance: when the balance cannot pay for the next video the scheduler PAUSES the series (it never overdraws), so create_series and resume_series refuse with SERIES_NEEDS_CREDITS instead of making a series that would never run. Agents may keep at most 5 series active at once (SERIES_LIMIT_REACHED). StoryShort has no per-key daily spending cap: pause_series is the brake. Requires the "video:create" scope.
name: resume_series
title: Resume a series
